refusal: bio.viz: a specification is an object: { format, chart, settings, filters }.

case: not JSON
refusal: bio.viz: a specification given as text must be JSON: ...

case: another format
refusal: bio.viz: this is not a bio.viz specification: its `format` must be "bio.viz specification".

case: another format version
refusal: bio.viz: this specification is of format version 2, and this version of bio.viz reads version 1.

case: a member it does not have
refusal: bio.viz: a specification has no `data`: it holds format, format_version, bio_viz_version, chart, settings, filters.

case: a version that is not text
refusal: bio.viz: a specification’s `bio_viz_version` is text, the version that wrote it.

case: no version
refusal: bio.viz: a specification’s `bio_viz_version` is text, the version that wrote it.

case: a chart bio.viz does not have
refusal: bio.viz: this specification names the chart "pie-chart", which bio.viz does not have. Its charts are group-comparison, association-scatter, correlation-matrix, biomarker-screen, cross-tab, stratified-survival.

case: a setting the chart does not have
refusal: bio.viz: this specification of the cross-tab chart, written by bio.viz 0.2.0, holds `colour`, which is not a setting of that chart in this version.

case: the page's connection
refusal: bio.viz: this specification of the cross-tab chart, written by bio.viz 0.2.0, holds `connection`, which is not a setting of that chart in this version.

case: settings that are not an object
refusal: bio.viz: a specification’s `settings` is an object of settings.

case: a filters setting that is not a list
refusal: bio.viz: the setting `filters` of a specification is a list of filters, or null.

case: a setting that names __proto__
refusal: bio.viz: `row_by` names `__proto__`, which is no column’s name.

case: a setting named __proto__
refusal: bio.viz: this specification of the cross-tab chart, written by bio.viz 0.2.0, holds `__proto__`, which is not a setting of that chart in this version.

case: filters that are not a list
refusal: bio.viz: a specification’s `filters` is a list of { column, operator, values }.

case: a filter that is not an object
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1 must be { column, operator, values }.

case: a filter with more than it has
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1 has `label`: a filter is { column, operator, values }.

case: a filter with no column
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1 must name its column.

case: a filter on constructor
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1 is on `constructor`, which is no column’s name.

case: a filter on prototype
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1 is on `prototype`, which is no column’s name.

case: a column filtered twice
refusal: bio.viz: filter 2 is on SEX, which filter 1 is already on: a column is filtered once.

case: an operator it does not have
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1, on SEX, has the operator "eq"; the operators are "in": in, the values it lets through.

case: values that are not a list
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1, on SEX, must list the values it lets through: text or numbers.

case: a value that is not text or a number
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1, on SEX, must list the values it lets through: text or numbers.

case: a value twice
refusal: bio.viz: filter 1, on AGE, names 35 twice: a value is listed once.

case: nested more than 64 deep
refusal: bio.viz: `title` must be text, which may hold placeholders such as {n}, or null for none.

case: a choice the chart does not have
refusal: bio.viz: `percent` must be one of row, col, none.

case: a test the chart does not have
refusal: bio.viz: `test` must be one of t, wilcoxon, anova, kruskal, none.

case: a title that is not text
refusal: bio.viz: `title` must be text, which may hold placeholders such as {n}, or null for none.

case: footnotes that are not texts
refusal: bio.viz: `footnotes` must be text, or a list of texts, or null for none.

case: a mark the chart does not have
refusal: bio.viz: `mark` must be one of box, violin, points.

case: a page below nought
refusal: bio.viz: `page` must be a whole number, from 0: the page of rows it opens on.

case: a limit of nought
refusal: bio.viz: `limit` must be a whole number, one or more.

case: a sort it does not have
refusal: bio.viz: `sort` must be one of estimate, name, adjusted.

case: a view it does not have
refusal: bio.viz: `view` must be one of grid, scatters.

case: a png_scale beyond 4
refusal: bio.viz: `png_scale` must be a number from 1 to 4: image pixels per CSS pixel.

case: downloads that is not true or false
refusal: bio.viz: `downloads` must be true or false.

case: a profile that is not true or false
refusal: bio.viz: `profile` must be true or false.

case: a waiting note of white space
refusal: bio.viz: `waiting_note` must be a sentence, or null for none.

case: a page size that is not whole
refusal: bio.viz: `page_size` must be a whole number, one or more.

case: details that are not columns
refusal: bio.viz: `details` holds something that is not a column name or { value_col, label }.

case: a study day column that is not a name
refusal: bio.viz: `studyday_col` must be the name of a column, or null.
